eSign PDF

Draw your signature and stamp it onto any page of a PDF. Choose the page, position and size with sliders, then download the signed document.

eSign PDF

Draw your signature and stamp it onto any page of your PDF.

No file loaded yet.

Please note: this adds a drawn signature image to the document — it is not a certified cryptographic digital signature. Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a PDF file — its page count appears once loaded.
  2. Draw your signature in the white box (mouse or touch), and clear it to retry.
  3. Enter the page number and adjust the X, Y and size sliders.
  4. Click "Sign & Download" to get your signed PDF.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is this a legally certified digital signature?

No. This adds a drawn signature image to the document. It is not a certified cryptographic digital signature.

How do I place the signature exactly where I want it?

Use the X and Y sliders to move the signature, and the size slider to scale it. Position is a percentage of the page width and height.

How do I draw my signature?

Press and hold the mouse button (or your finger on touch screens) and write inside the white signature box, then click Sign.
